Built on good foundations.

This version uses established rendering and animation libraries, with an original composition and scroll sequence.

Libraries

  • Three.js 0.180.0 — WebGL rendering, buffer geometry, points, materials, and built-in torus-knot geometry. MIT license.
  • GSAP, ScrollTrigger & SplitText 3.13.0 — scroll-linked timelines, accessible masked typography, responsive section choreography, and the animation ticker. Standard license. Copyright notices are retained in the distributed files.
  • Lenis 1.3.11 — smooth scrolling, using the documented GSAP ticker and ScrollTrigger integration. MIT license.

Techniques & inspiration

  • Bruno Simon: Crafting Scroll Based Animations in Three.js — the fixed WebGL canvas behind HTML, camera-group parallax, section-based composition, and capped pixel ratio.
  • Bruno Simon's portfolio — inspiration for treating an engineering portfolio as an interactive experience. No vehicle, models, or site assets were copied.
  • ScrollTrigger documentation — scrubbed timelines mapped to document scrolling.
  • Codrops: On-Scroll 3D Stack Motion Effect — the pinned frame and depth transitions between readable project cards.
  • Official GSAP skills and LottieFiles motion-design skill — choreography, reading holds, responsive cleanup, and accessible motion. The local review workflow uses GSDevTools; no development controls are shipped.

The 3D formations are abstract visual motifs, not plots of actual company relationships or financial observations. Career and project information comes from my resume.
